
QUERY-ESTIMATION-GUIDE
Get estimation guidance based on historical data for a work unit

WHEN TO USE
  Use after generating scenarios from Example Mapping to get data-driven estimation guidance based on similar historical work.

USAGE
  fspec query-estimation-guide <workUnitId> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID

OPTIONS
  --similar <count>
    Number of similar work units to analyze

EXAMPLES
  1. Get estimation guidance
  $ fspec query-estimation-guide AUTH-001
  Based on 5 similar work units:
  Suggested estimate: 5 points
  Range: 3-8 points
  Average actual: 5.2 points

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec update-work-unit-estimate
  fspec query-estimate-accuracy
